title: Beyond Training for Cultural Awareness: The Role of Dataset Linguistic Structure in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fine-tuned large language models on benchmarks that assess cultural knowledge, cultural values, and cultural norms (e.g., CulturalBench, World Values Survey/WorldValuesBench, Hofstede's VSM13) across Arabic, Chinese, and Japanese languages. The study correlates this cultural alignment performance with the linguistic and structural properties of the models' fine-tuning datasets derived via Principal Component Analysis (PCA).
